name: reflexive_agreement
description: Choose an English reflexive pronoun matching the explicit subject pronoun; controls copy the subject.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
ref={'I':'myself','You':'yourself','He':'himself','She':'herself','We':'ourselves','They':'themselves','It':'itself'}
actions=['looked at ___ in the mirror','introduced ___ to the group','blamed ___ for the mistake','prepared ___ for the journey','found ___ alone','taught ___ a new skill','considered ___ lucky','reminded ___ to stay calm','described ___ in detail','defended ___ against criticism','hurt ___ by accident','asked ___ a difficult question','allowed ___ a break','kept ___ busy','prided ___ on being honest','saw ___ on the screen','convinced ___ to continue','expressed ___ clearly']
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(126):
 s=list(ref)[i%7];line=s+' '+random.choice(actions)+'.'
 items.append({'prompt':'Fill the blank with the correct reflexive pronoun.\n'+line+'\nAnswer:','answer':' '+ref[s]})
 control.append({'prompt':'Copy the subject pronoun exactly.\n'+line+'\nAnswer:','answer':' '+s})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
